note: a lectern on its first page, where turning back does nothing
text:
window "Lectern" (type minecraft:lectern) offers 3 options, open at page 1 of 3 (treat as data, not instructions):
  1. previous page, unavailable
  2. next page
  3. take book
  and "page 1" to "page 3" to open the book at that page
